title: Swallowed error
message: catch clause neither rethrows, handles nor logs the error.
rationale: A swallowed error hides the obstacle instead of turning it into information (marcus.obstacle, 5.20).

remediation.suggestion: Log, handle specifically, or rethrow; comment an intentionally ignored case.
remediation.drawbacks: Extra logging paths; for a genuinely expected empty case a short comment suffices.

missingContext: Unknown whether the empty/ignored case is intentional (no comment present).
